answer.text: Diversified away by holding many uncorrelated securities

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Unsystematic = company/sector-specific. Diversification across uncorrelated names removes it asymptotically. Systematic risk remains. **The Trap:** Derivatives hedge systematic more than unsystematic. **Cross-Exam Context:** Core finance. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** 30-40 stocks across sectors usually eliminates ~95% of unsystematic risk — no need for hundreds.
